description: Same as read_url plus a heuristic prompt-injection check: flags hidden/invisible text, instruction-like phrases ("ignore previous instructions", role reassignment, secret exfiltration, chat-template tokens), suspicious HTML comments and zero-width/Unicode-tag characters. Returns injection_check {flagged, risk none|low|medium|high, signals}. Heuristic, not a guarantee. Failed reads are not charged. Costs $0.003 USDC per call via x402.
name: read_url_safe
